title: Iris
description: Nine black anodised aperture blades over Revolver propped on a record shelf under festoon bulbs. Turn the ring from f/1.4 to f/16: the bulbs fall from nine-sided bokeh discs into 18-point stars, every stop clicks into its detent and the blades swish as they close.
intent: One optical object finished to the edge: a real nine-blade iris whose opening is the shape of every bokeh disc and the source of every diffraction spike, with the foley of a manual lens ring.
